title_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Orientim Perfekt!!
description_sq: Ne Don Bosko, tek kompleksi Al-Mak, Shitet Apartament 1+1, me Vendndodhje dhe Orientim Perfekt!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e gjashte banim te nje pallati te ri, me ashensor. Organizimi i apartamentit fillon me korridorin qe ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e ndenjes bashke me ambientin e ngrenies dhe te gatimit, nje dhome gjumi me dalje ne ballkon, nje tualet dhe nje ballkon. Zona ofron shume facilitete duke nisur nga lokacioni perfekt dhe per kete arsye eshte nje mundesi shume e mire si per te jetuar ashtu edhe per investim duke qene se qirate jane shume te larta ne ate zone. Disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In Don Bosco, 1+1 apartment for sale, with perfect orientation!!
description_en: In Don Bosco, at the Al-Mak complex, 1+1 Apartment for sale, with Perfect Location and Orientation!!! The apartment is located on the sixth residential floor of a new building, with an elevator. The apartment has a gross area of ​​54 m2 and a net area of ​​49 m2. The organization of the apartment begins with the corridor that divides the living room with the dining and cooking area, a bedroom with access to the balcony, a toilet and a balcony. Orientation from the South-West makes this light throughout the day. The apartment has just been fully invested by the owner, starting from the multi-layer hydraulic system, flush toilet, electrical system, doors, double-glazed windows, parquet, patina, etc. The area offers many facilities starting from the perfect location and for this reason it is a very good opportunity both for living and for investment since the rents are very high in that area. It has full mortgage documentation.
